settings_log_level_desc: Minimum severity to log. Choose Off to disable.
settings_log_to_file_desc: Also append log entries to `zotlit.log.jsonl` in the plugin folder.
settings_log_open_file_desc: Open the current log file in the system default application.
settings_log_export_desc: Save the log file as a zip file.

command_import_all_notes_name: Import all child and standalone notes
notice_empty_filename: The filename template rendered an empty name. Adjust the template and try again.

notice_update_metadata_no_note: No literature note to update. Use Create or Update Literature Note to make one.

modal_overwrite_note_desc: Replace the note body with the ZotLit note template. Frontmatter keys managed by ZotLit are refreshed, and other frontmatter keys are kept.
modal_reimport_note_desc: Overwrite this file with the latest content from Zotero. Any local edits will be lost.
batch_update_db_unavailable: Open the Zotero database to update notes.
batch_update_confirm_none: None of these {count} items are in Zotero. There is nothing to update or create.

batch_update_progress_warning: Keep this dialog open until the import finishes.
batch_import_summary: Import complete. {created} created, {updated} updated, {skipped} skipped, {failed} failed, {notFound} not found.
batch_import_confirm_none: None of these {count} items are notes in Zotero. There is nothing to import.

notice_no_citekey: Selected item has no citation key: {key}.
notice_template_not_ready: Templates are still loading. Try again in a moment.
notice_citekey_not_found: No Zotero item with citation key @{citekey}.
notice_citekey_db_unavailable: Open the Zotero database to look up citation key @{citekey}.
settings_db_profile_dir_desc: Determines where ZotLit reads your Zotero library.
settings_db_device_override_note: Stored on this device only. It doesn't sync to your other devices.
settings_db_read_mode_desc: While Zotero is running, it holds the database file open. This setting controls how ZotLit reads it without interfering. Auto picks the best available method.
settings_db_read_mode_reflink_desc: Fast, lightweight snapshot: sees recent edits
settings_db_read_mode_copy_desc: Full database copy: sees recent edits, but slower and uses more disk space
settings_db_read_mode_immutable_desc: Reads the database directly: recent edits may not appear immediately
notice_db_reflink_unsupported: Reflink clones are unavailable on this volume. ZotLit is reading the immutable Zotero database.
settings_db_auto_refresh_desc: Reload automatically when `zotero.sqlite` changes on disk.
settings_db_data_dir_desc: Override where ZotLit reads `zotero.sqlite`. Use only when Zotero runs on a non-default profile.
settings_db_source_id_desc: Live updates are accepted only from a Zotero install whose profile and data directory match these.
settings_db_library_desc: Library used when inserting citations or listing items.
settings_db_library_unavailable: Open the Zotero database to choose a library.
annot_view_empty: Open a literature note to see annotations.
annot_view_empty_reader: Open an item in the Zotero reader to see its annotations.
annot_view_follow_reader_disabled_toolti: Enable live updates in settings to follow the Zotero reader
annot_view_filter_no_match: No annotations match the current filters
annot_view_copy_citation_no_key: This item has no citation key; nothing to copy
settings_page_frontmatter_desc: Map YAML properties added to every literature note.
settings_page_database_desc: Connect ZotLit to your Zotero library.
settings_page_citations_desc: Configure citation suggestions, the citation index, and citation keys in the editor.
settings_page_templates_desc: Customize how notes, annotations, and citations render.
settings_page_attachments_desc: Import annotation images and attachments into the vault.
settings_page_note_import_desc: Configure how notes from Zotero are imported into the vault.
settings_page_diagnostics_desc: Logs and recovery tools for troubleshooting.
settings_note_folder_desc: Where new literature notes are created.
settings_note_import_folder_desc: Where notes imported from Zotero are saved.
settings_note_import_annotations_templat: Render annotation paragraphs in imported notes with the annotation template, sourced from Zotero. In-place edits to those paragraphs in Zotero will be discarded.
settings_citation_suggester_desc: Suggest Zotero items while typing `[@` in the editor.
settings_citation_at_trigger_desc: Also open the suggester on a bare `@` at a word boundary. The query ends at the first space; type `_` where the search needs a space.
settings_citation_show_citekey_desc: Show each item's citation key beside its title in the suggester.
settings_citation_pandoc_citations_desc: Include Pandoc citations such as `@doe2024` in the references sidebar and ZotLit’s in-text features. This setting does not change citation insertion or export.
settings_citation_wikilink_citations_des: Include unaliased links to literature notes in the references sidebar and ZotLit’s in-text features. Heading links, block links, and invalid citation fragments stay as links. This setting does not change export.
settings_citation_show_formatted_desc: Show citations in Live Preview and reading view with the selected citation and references style. Source mode always shows Markdown. Citations stay unchanged when ZotLit cannot format them.
settings_citation_open_pandoc_links_desc: Open and preview literature notes from Pandoc citations. This setting does not change how citations are shown.
settings_citation_references_style_desc: CSL style used to format in-text citations and the references sidebar. Install and manage styles in Zotero.
settings_citation_references_style_warni: This style isn’t installed in Zotero. Install it in Zotero or select another style.
settings_citation_engine_desc: Formats in-text citations, references, and exports. Installation applies to every vault on this device.
settings_citation_engine_status_absent: Not installed. References stay a plain list until you install it.
settings_citation_engine_status_installi: Downloading the engine. This takes a while.
settings_citation_engine_status_hash_mis: The download did not match the pinned checksum, so ZotLit discarded it. Try again.
settings_citation_pandoc_guide_desc: ZotLit reference for the native Pandoc workflow.
settings_citation_pandoc_files_desc: Save the version-matched filter and defaults file to one folder. Keep both files together.
settings_citation_pandoc_folder_title: Select a folder for Pandoc integration files
settings_citation_pandoc_replace_body: This replaces {files} and writes the complete pair. If the save fails, ZotLit restores the prior pair.
notice_pandoc_engine_removed: Removed the Pandoc engine from this device.
notice_pandoc_engine_remove_failed: Could not remove the Pandoc engine.
notice_citation_style_missing: The selected citation and references style isn’t installed in Zotero.
notice_pandoc_integration_saved: Saved the Pandoc integration pair to {folder}.
notice_pandoc_integration_save_failed: Could not save the Pandoc integration pair. The prior pair was restored.
notice_pandoc_integration_restore_failed: Could not save or restore the Pandoc integration pair. Check both files before use.
cited_by_open_literature_note: Open a literature note to see citations.
cited_by_empty: No notes cite this literature note.
cited_by_coverage_degraded: Some notes could not be indexed.
cited_by_resolution_degraded: Some citations that use citation keys may be unavailable.
references_empty: The active note cites no literature notes.
references_db_unavailable: Open the Zotero database to see references.
references_item_missing: {linkpath} points to an item that is no longer in your Zotero library.
references_citekey_unresolved: @{citekey} matches no item in your Zotero library.
references_citation_fragment_invalid: This link has an invalid citation fragment.
references_open_note_invalid_fragment: Fix the citation fragment to open its note

match.count=1: Go to the citation in this note
match.count=*: Go to the next citation in this note (cited {count} times)

references_open_note_missing: No literature note — item is missing
references_open_note_unresolved: No Zotero item for this citation key
references_engine_hint_body: Install the Pandoc engine to format this list with your citation and references style.
references_format_failed_title: ZotLit could not format these references
references_format_failed_body: The plain reference list is shown. Check the citation and references style and Pandoc engine in settings.
pandoc_export_style_desc: CSL style for the citations and the bibliography. Starts with your citation and references style.
pandoc_export_error_citation_intent: These links carry a #cite: fragment but point to notes that are not literature notes:
pandoc_export_error_database: ZotLit cannot read the Zotero database in {dataDir}. Check the database settings and try again.
pandoc_export_error_items_missing: Zotero holds no item for these literature notes:
pandoc_export_error_citation_keys_missin: Better BibTeX holds no citation key for these literature notes:
pandoc_export_error_zotero_closed: Start Zotero and try again. ZotLit reads bibliography data from Zotero on port {port}.
pandoc_export_error_local_api: Turn on the local API in Zotero → Settings → Advanced → Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero ({pref}), then try again.
pandoc_export_error_destination: ZotLit cannot write the exported document: {detail}
notice_pandoc_export_engine_missing: Install the Pandoc engine to export from Obsidian.
settings_note_frontmatter_order_desc: Drag to reorder. New notes use this order; existing notes keep their current property order.
settings_note_frontmatter_system_zotero_: Always written. Identifies the Zotero item this note belongs to.
settings_note_frontmatter_reset_confirm_: Replace your frontmatter fields with the built-in default? Your changes will be lost.
settings_frontmatter_expr_desc: Expression evaluated over the item, e.g. `zt.title`.
settings_frontmatter_language_desc: Language the expression is written in.
settings_frontmatter_expr_readonly_js: JavaScript templates are disabled on this device, so this expression can't be edited. Switch the language to Liquid to rewrite it.
settings_frontmatter_inert_js: This field is inactive because JavaScript templates are disabled on this device.
settings_frontmatter_merge_desc: Controls how ZotLit updates this property when refreshing frontmatter.
settings_frontmatter_error_reserved: '{key}' is managed by ZotLit and can't be used.
settings_template_folder_desc: Where editable template files are created and loaded from.
settings_template_auto_pair_desc: Insert a matching `%>` while editing templates.
settings_template_trim_desc: Strip a newline, strip all whitespace, or keep it.
settings_template_js_enable_desc: Turn on JavaScript templates to let Eta templates (.eta.md) run JavaScript code.
settings_template_js_confirm_body: Eta templates run JavaScript with the same access as ZotLit itself: they can read and modify your vault, connect to the internet, and on desktop, access your system. Only enable this if you trust every template file in your vault.
settings_template_reset_confirm_body: Replace '{name}' with the built-in default? Your changes will be lost.
settings_template_shadowed: The Eta template at {path} is ignored because a Liquid template with the same name takes precedence.
settings_template_inert_eta: The Eta template at {path} is inactive because JavaScript templates are disabled on this device.
settings_template_switch_eta_confirm_bod: The Liquid template for {name} at '{path}' will be moved to trash so the JavaScript (Eta) edition can take over.
settings_template_switch_liquid_confirm_: The JavaScript (Eta) template for {name} at '{path}' will be moved to trash so the Liquid edition can take over.
settings_template_compile_error: Compile error — this template will not render until you fix it. It does not fall back to the default.
settings_template_desc_note: Body of a new literature note.
settings_template_desc_content: Managed region that will be overwritten on note update.
settings_template_desc_filename: Filename of a new literature note. Use a forward slash (/) to route the note into subfolders under the literature note folder.
cli_template_data_desc: Return serialized ZotLit Template data, payload under 'zt'
cli_template_schema_desc: Return download URLs for every ZotLit Template data schema
cli_template_render_desc: Render an active ZotLit Template in memory, rendered bytes under 'markdown'
cli_template_guide_desc: Print the ZotLit Template Workbench guide
cli_template_source_desc: Return the active ZotLit Template body, under 'source'
cli_frontmatter_status_desc: Report the configured ZotLit Managed Frontmatter fields
cli_frontmatter_eval_desc: Evaluate ZotLit Managed Frontmatter fields, or one ad-hoc expression, against an item
cli_frontmatter_set_desc: Add or update one ZotLit Managed Frontmatter field; omitted parameters on an existing field keep their current values
cli_frontmatter_remove_desc: Delete one ZotLit Managed Frontmatter field
cli_frontmatter_reorder_desc: Arrange the configured ZotLit Managed Frontmatter fields into a new order
cli_flag_expr_desc: Ad-hoc frontmatter expression to evaluate instead of the configured fields
cli_flag_field_desc: Managed Frontmatter field key to add or update
cli_flag_frontmatter_set_expr_desc: Field expression; required for a new field, keeps the current expression when omitted on an existing field
cli_flag_frontmatter_set_language_desc: Field language; defaults to liquid on a new field, keeps the current language when omitted on an existing field
cli_flag_frontmatter_set_merge_desc: Merge strategy; defaults to replace on a new field, keeps the current strategy when omitted on an existing field
cli_flag_frontmatter_remove_field_desc: Managed Frontmatter field key to delete
cli_flag_order_desc: Complete, comma-separated permutation of the configured field keys, in write order
cli_resolve_desc: Resolve the literature note links of one file to citation keys, for the ZotLit Pandoc filter
cli_flag_file_desc: Absolute path to the Markdown file
cli_pandoc_files_desc: Return the version-matched ZotLit Pandoc integration pair
cli_pandoc_guide_desc: Print the ZotLit Pandoc CLI guide
settings_attachment_import_desc: Copy annotation images and embedded attachments into the vault.
settings_attachment_folder_desc: Where imported attachments are stored. Leave empty to use Obsidian's default.
settings_attachment_approved_desc: Add a folder here when Zotero uses linked attachments stored outside its storage folder, annotation cache, or configured base attachment folder. ZotLit can then copy imported attachments from that location; other sources are linked instead of copied.
settings_attachment_approved_policy_desc: Approval applies to future imports; re-import previously imported notes to copy attachments that were skipped.
settings_page_live_updates_desc: Receive live updates from Zotero as you read and annotate.
settings_live_updates_enabled_desc: Run a local listener so the Zotero plugin can push changes to Obsidian.
settings_live_updates_companion_desc: Install the Zotero companion add-on and enable its Obsidian notifications to complete the connection.
settings_live_updates_port_desc: Point the Zotero plugin at http://127.0.0.1:<port> to connect it.
settings_live_updates_hostname_desc: Address the listener binds to. Keep on 127.0.0.1 unless you know you need network access.
notice_template_delete_failed: Failed to move template file to trash.
notice_frontmatter_js_inert: These frontmatter fields are inactive because JavaScript templates are disabled: {fields}.
notice_protocol_source_mismatch: This link was created by a different Zotero install.
notice_protocol_db_unavailable: Open the Zotero database to handle this link.
notice_protocol_update_obsidian: Update the ZotLit Obsidian plugin to use this Zotero companion.
notice_protocol_update_zotero: Update the ZotLit Zotero companion to use this Obsidian plugin.
notice_installer_update_explanation: The automatic updater cannot update a part of Obsidian that ZotLit needs. To update it:
notice_installer_update_no_uninstall: You do not need to uninstall Obsidian first.
notice_citation_index_reset: Citation index cleared. ZotLit is rebuilding it in the background.
notice_citation_index_reset_failed: Couldn't reset the citation index. Check the log for details.
notice_language_pack_install: ZotLit language pack for {language} is available.
notice_language_pack_download_failed: Couldn't download the ZotLit language pack. {message}
notice_language_pack_restart: Restart Obsidian to apply the ZotLit language pack.
notice_language_pack_update_needed: Update ZotLit to install the ZotLit language pack.
notice_language_pack_reset: Language packs removed. Restart Obsidian to apply.
settings_update_notices_desc: Show a notice linking to the release notes after ZotLit updates.
settings_language_pack_desc: Show ZotLit's interface in {language}. Installing downloads a language pack.
settings_citation_index_reset_desc: Clear the stored citation key scans and rebuild them from your vault. Use this when the references sidebar disagrees with what a note cites.
settings_citation_index_reset_confirm_bo: The stored scans are cleared and ZotLit reads your notes again. Nothing in your vault changes.
settings_language_pack_reset_desc: Remove downloaded language packs and forget whether they were offered before. Use this when translated text looks wrong or outdated.
settings_language_pack_reset_confirm_bod: Downloaded language packs are removed. ZotLit offers to install them again after a restart.
settings_resources_whats_new_desc: See what changed in this release.
settings_resources_docs_desc: Guides and reference for setting up and using ZotLit.
settings_resources_help_desc: Ask questions, suggest features, and connect with other ZotLit users.
settings_resources_bug_report_desc: File a bug report with steps to reproduce and debug logs.
template_data_explorer_empty_hint: Choose a Zotero item to explore the template data it receives
welcome_step_connect_checking: Looking for Zotero in your default profile…
welcome_step_connect_missing: We couldn't find your Zotero data directory.
welcome_step_folder_body: New notes default to the {folder} folder. Change it any time.
welcome_pick_folder_placeholder: Choose a folder for new literature notes
welcome_step_note_body: Search your library and turn any item into a fully-templated note.
welcome_keep_going_body: Guides and references for when you want to go deeper.
welcome_migration_body: Custom Eta templates are not loaded until you rename them and enable the JavaScript Templates gate.
